notes: Summary: SonicLoom builds live audio personalization for podcasts and interactive streams. Extremely sensitive to tail latency (p50 < 60ms, p95 < 180ms) and per-token cost due to high-traffic peak windows.
Workload profile: short-context voice interactions (avg tokens 30-80), embedding lookups for personalization, reranker for ad insertion decisioning.
What they told us: "We need predictable sub-100ms interactive responses for a 50k concurrent sessions burst. Cost per million tokens will make/break the bid."
POC ask: 3-week perf benchmark comparing baseline open model on k8s vs Redwood Dedicated + Optimize tuned config. Focus on batching/caching and 4-bit quantization profiles for cost parity.
Perf requirements: metric set defined in perf spreadsheet (latency histograms, tokens/sec, cost-per-1M-tokens, failover time), need exportable dashboards.

Batching/caching notes: customer can tolerate modest batching for throughput but wants dynamic small-window batching for voice to avoid increasing p95. Interested in our prefix/KV cache to cut repeated prompt tokens during conversation flows.
Quantization: engineering lead asked about 4-bit and productized mixed-precision; worried about hallucination/regression — wants quality checks tied to prompt set.
Security/compliance: must keep PII out of hosted logs; preference for VPC + envelope encryption (KMS). Retention policy: 30 days default, special-case retention for EU users.
Quote (CTO): "If you can show 2x cost reduction with equal p95 under load we'll move to Dedicated."
Initial competitor eval: they tried ModelX managed endpoints (good latency but expensive), and self-hosting (cheap but operationally brittle). Looking for middle ground.
Internal stakeholders: CTO (decision), Head of ML Infra (POC owner), Streaming Eng manager (latency owner), Product (OKR: lower ad decision latency).
POC constraints: cannot expose raw audio to external third parties without NDA; currently delaying demo artifacts until NDA in place.

Recommended Redwood approach: run two bench scenarios: 1) hosted_api streaming with Optimize suggestions (dynamic batching + KV cache); 2) Dedicated reserved pool with quantized model + adaptive batching. Capture cost/latency delta and report p50/p95/p99 under synthetic and recorded traffic.
Sales notes: propose 3-month pilot - first month evaluation (benchmarks), second month integration + rollout test, third month production ramp. Pricing levers: reserved burst capacity for ad peaks.
Action items to close: 1) legal to circulate NDA (Maya), 2) SE to finalize perf plan (Diego), 3) infra to confirm VPC network path (Priya).
